researcher_notes: Re-checked match: no GGIT row (snapshot 20260930) or roster entry names Apsheronsk/Kubanskaya/Tverskaya/Vpered/Yerik; nearest P1475 Maykop-Samur-Sochi and Rostov-Maykop are unrelated trunks -> not matched_existing. Operator release (gazpromgk.ru item 8612, 9 Oct 2025; url_verifier OK on the /press/news/i/item/8612/ form, contains '37,3'): GGK commissioned the inter-settlement gas pipeline 'Apsheronsk - kh. Kalinina - s. Vpered - p. Yerik - st. Kubanskaya - st. Tverskaya', 37.3 km, built under PAO Gazprom's Program for development of gas supply and gasification of Krasnodar Krai 2021-2025; ceremony at GRPSh in s. Vpered during the St Petersburg International Gas Forum 2025; 19.3 km of distribution networks already laid from it; enables gasification of five settlements (>2.1k households per second source). Second source kubantoday.ru relays the Krasnodar Krai administration press service with the same 37.3 km (different publisher/originator, but same event, so independence is modest). 1istochnik.ru ceremony roundup (not cited as length source) names the same five settlements. Add-threshold: sponsor = Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Krasnodar / PAO Gazprom program; endpoints known; concrete step = commissioned Oct 2025 (built, never captured); length 37.3 km >= 25 sourced -> passes all four legs. Scope: inter-settlement supply spur from the gas network, not an urban distribution network; PipelineType=distribution (tracker carries 48 such rows). Not found: diameter, pressure, capacity, cost, construction year, which network feeds the Apsheronsk start (no source). Parent/ownership chain not stated in the releases (GGK is operator/builder; Parent left blank; entity_lookup found no existing 'Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Krasnodar' entity -> new entity, owner share not sourced). Route not researched (no official GIS found); endpoints known so RouteType = Not mapped (could be). Tier medium: one operator primary validated, second republication of administration release.
